description: Orders up to 50 documents by relevance to a query with the BGE reranker and returns rank, index and score for each. Use it after a keyword or vector search to pick the best few. Scores compare documents within one call only. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
